title: File:Aerial View of Mauna Loa with Smoke (6fb95a77-6977-446f-91b8-bf495e631654).tif
author: US Army Air Corps; 11th Photo Section
description:
Black and white photograph of Mauna Loa taken from a bird’s-eye view. The terrain appears steep and barren. In the center of the photograph, the land splits slightly, allowing opaque white clouds of smoke to escape. The smoke drifts upwards towards the left, taking up a large portion of the middle and left sides.
Aerial view of Mauna Loa with smoke, captured by the 11th Photo Section, Air Service USA.

title: File:Aerial View of Mauna Loa with Steam (542ab120-2b74-4274-9151-50b317a2eeed).tif
author: US Army Air Corps; 11th Photo Section
description:
Black and white photograph of Mauna Loa taken from a bird’s-eye view. The terrain is flat and consists mostly of lava bedrock. In the center, cracks in the ground allow clouds of steam to escape. The steam forms thin, white clouds that drift towards the left side of the image. A handwritten number “5” is present in the bottom left corner.
Aerial view of Mauna Loa with steam, captured by the 11th Photo Section, Air Service USA.

title: File:Aerial View of Mauna Loa with Smoke (cfaf1a58-a48e-4026-ad3d-8e315d6141d3).tif
author: US Army Air Corps; 11th Photo Section
description:
Black and white photograph of Mauna Loa taken from a bird’s-eye view. The terrain appears steep, rocky, and barren. In the center of the photograph, the land splits slightly, allowing opaque white clouds of smoke to escape. The smoke drifts towards the left, taking up a large portion of the lefthand side. Towards the bottom left side two lava flows can be seen running towards the bottom left corner.  A handwritten number “7” is present in the bottom left corner.
Aerial view of Mauna Loa with steam and lava, captured by the 11th Photo Section, Air Service USA.
